summary: Canary HBAR ETF filed an 8-K reporting amendments to its trust and sponsor agreements to authorize a HBAR staking program. No acquisition, divestiture, or corporate action—merely operational updates for a crypto ETF. The trust will stake HBAR, with all staking rewards paid to the Sponsor as additional compensation, not affecting NAV. Shareholders have no management rights. This is a routine product update, not a special situation. Terms: no price/share, premium, or close date. What to watch: staking yields and regulatory treatment of rewards.
